subject: Music Production
title: Standing Waves and Bass Traps
description: A 60-second lesson on Standing Waves and Bass Traps.

hook.text: Walk around a small room playing loud bass and you'll notice some spots boom while others are quiet.

buildup.text: Bass waves bounce between walls and create standing waves with fixed loud and silent zones.

discovery.text: These standing waves make bass sound wildly uneven, ruining a producer's ability to judge low end.

twist.text: The problem gets worse in small rooms because bass waves are long enough to span entire walls.

climax.text: Bass traps placed in corners absorb low frequencies and smooth out the room's bass response.

punchline.text: Corners cause bass problems, and traps fix them.

quiz.question: What do standing waves in a room cause?
options: Fixed loud and silent zones for bass frequencies
